serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Who that might be?
#bot.Expression.Clear
You: Hello?
Lady Annalie: Hi~ Everything’s ok with you? 
You: Yeah, why are you asking?
Lady Annalie: You had to leave our meetup yesterday. Was it your lady calling or something else?
You: It was her.
Lady Annalie: You sound kinda tense~ Is she next to you, perhaps?
You: Yes.
Lady Annalie: Keeping your answers short will only make it more suspicious, you know?
You: Are you calling just to tease me or did something happen with Melissa?
Lady Annalie: Everything was fine, but I must say she knows how to keep a poker face, that girl.
Lady Annalie: I’m just letting you know that you can sign me up if you want to hang out again. Be it with {f_botName}, Melissa or both.
You: Sure, I will keep it in mind.
You: Anyway, what were you two talking about after I left?
Lady Annalie: Girl stuff~
You: I’m asking seriously…
Lady Annalie: Nothing much really, but she sure was interested in you. 
You: Really? What did you tell her?
Lady Annalie: The truth, of course!
You: Come on… I’m being serious.
Lady Annalie: And that was my serious answer! Would you rather get an unserious one? 
You: No, thank you.
Lady Annalie: She also told me about the way you two met. Uwah~ I got a secondhand embarrassment just listening to it! 
You: What exactly did she tell you?! I didn’t do anything THAT bad!
Lady Annalie: ‘THAT bad’? You are not really helping your case here, you know?
Lady Annalie: At first I didn’t want to believe her, but when she told me about the tampons, I shouted, ‘Yeah, that’s totally something he would do!’
Lady Annalie: I’m telling you, it was hilarious!
